The real problem is that "ORDINARY KRIGING IN R WITH GRASS6 DATA" is on a 
wiki with no responsible owner or maintainer, and no automatic way of 
synchronising it with current code:

http://grass.gdf-hannover.de/wiki/GRASS_6_Tutorial#GRASS_and_R_kriging_interpolation

The original is not signed, with no attached data sets or location, so we
can't ask anyone to keep it working.  I've added:

(WARNING!! Most of the code quoted here is very out of date, and simply 
does not work for current R/sp/gstat/spgrass6. Untried suggestions 
have been edited in, but without a test location, there is no 
guarantee that they will work! Roger Bivand, 5 April 2007)

at the top of the section, and tried to indicate the worst inaccuracies.

Roger

messages.subject: [STATSGRASS] pseudo variograms
messages.body_plain:
I have two questions about pseudo cross-variograms. It seems that they are only
calculated if the variables of interest are not co-located. Is there anyway to
calculate them even if the data is co-located? Cressie, 1991 pg 140 suggests
that using the 'classical' cross-variograms cannot guarantee optimal co-kriging
predictors. I would like to compare the results of each cross-variogram.
Secondly, if there is a way to calculate pseudo cross-variograms for co-located
data. Does the variogram function automatically standarize the variables? In
other  words, my three variables of interest DO NOT have the same measurement
units so each one of them should be standarized (by subtracting the mean and
dividing by the calculated standard deviation) for the empirical pseudo
cross-variogram equation to make any sense. Thanks ahead,
                                                                 Roberto
